About Johny

Johny came to us in May 2021. Children found him near a park and brought him to our shelter. He was microchipped, so we hoped we would be able to find his owner. Unfortunately, we discovered that his owner had passed away and that no one was left to care for him. At first, Johny had a hard time accepting other dogs and often showed his frustration. But with a lot of patience, daily work and love, Johny has made tremendous progress. Today, after almost five years with us, he is ready for his own home.  The shelter has helped him become a better and more confident dog, but now he needs what we cannot give him here – a family, peace, attention and his own safe garden where he can play and enjoy life. His ideal family would be someone with experience who is willing to continue working with him.
